profile.name: MD. RASEL HOSSAIN
profile.bio: Aviation professional with more than 12 years of experience in airline operations, customer service, load control, weight & balance management, and ULD operations. Currently serving as Senior Executive at Us-Bangla Airlines while performing dual responsibilities as Load Control Supervisor and Acting ULD In-Charge. Licensed in Aircraft Load & Trim for ATR, B737, Dash-8 and A330. Experienced in web application development, aviation process automation, roster systems, and operational dashboard design.

technology: Personal portfolio and aviation technology projects

experience.role: Senior Executive | Load Control Supervisor | Acting ULD In-Charge

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
items: Supervise aircraft load control operations and ensure regulatory compliance.
Prepare and verify load sheets, trim sheets, weight & balance calculations.
Coordinate with ground handling, boarding gate, ramp and flight crew.
Manage passenger service operations, irregularities and service recovery.
Monitor flight documentation and operational reporting.
Lead and guide operational teams during peak operations.

sections.title: ULD In-Charge Responsibilities
items: Control ULD inventory, stock positioning and allocation.
Coordinate ULD movement between stations and vendors.
Monitor ULD serviceability and damage reporting.
Maintain ULD tracking records and reconciliation reports.
Ensure availability of AKE, PMC, PAG, PLA and other ULD equipment.
Liaise with cargo, ground handling and engineering departments.
Analyze shortages and arrange redistribution to support flight operations.

sections.title: Core Responsibilities
items: Handled customer relations, service delivery, administration and complaint resolution.

licenses: Aircraft Load & Trim License (ATR, Boeing 737, Dash-8, Airbus A330)
